decisions.summary: Inputs captured from fit_field's arguments, deep-copied per method; the prototype reuses the engine's skeleton steps (_comb_skeleton through round_channel_joints) as carve_comb calls them
decisions.why: FR-002 asks for the same skeleton for each trial size and the spec's Assumptions name the skeleton builders as inputs, not the thing replaced; reusing them makes the comparison like for like. Their cost is in both methods' times.

decisions.summary: Per trial size, the planted region = the carve's envelope less _water(channels) less _outside_command(...); its area is the acreage; no plots cut in the search
decisions.why: The spec's Planted region entity and FR-007 (acreage read from the region without cutting plots). The three geometries are the ones CombCarve.planted_area and close_seams already take as the ground to be planted (comb.py planted_area), so the region is the same ground the finished acreage is measured on. Legality is D8's question.

decisions.summary: Partition: per sector, row and column lines at the carve's falls and nsub divisions, wobble and wander kept, clipped to the region; cells = polygonize of the noded union
decisions.why: FR-006 (region cut by row and column bunds, every bund shared as laid) and FR-009 (rows along the contour with wander, columns across each sector).

decisions.summary: A violating cell is merged into the neighbor whose union holds the rules; what no merge can make legal is reported, not hidden; toe slivers merged
decisions.why: FR-008 and User Story 2 scenario 3 say merge OR SPLIT, naming the staircase, 'the way the repair resolves it today', and the repair today splits staircases (seams/close.py hold_ring_rules -> _split_steps). D4 removes split and lets a residue that no merge fixes stand as a reported violation: an exception to FR-008/SC-003 ('no plot with a ring_violations finding'). Not impossible (the prototype may import _split_steps), not implied by the GM, and it could also produce a NO-GO that the spec reserves for a construction shown unable to hold the rules, when only the split was left out. Fix: merge or split at construction, as the repair does; a cell neither resolves is an SC-003 failure that leaves the prototype unfinished, not a reported residue.

decisions.summary: Dry hem, beans and net assembly run on the prototype's plots, inside its timed cost
decisions.why: SC-004: the speed is not bought by leaving work out; FR-009 keeps the dry hem and beans.

decisions.summary: Harness computes the verdict: fastest of three back to back, totals, each method's spread, GO when current - prototype > the larger spread; SC-003 checks printed per input
decisions.why: SC-001 and FR-004/FR-005 as written; the four validity checks are SC-003's four.

decisions.summary: Phase 1: the partition replaces _carve's plot cutting, _comb_toe_and_hem's drop, close_seams and planted_area for comb fields; uncalled seam machinery deleted with its rules carried by construction tests; polder and hill unchanged
decisions.why: FR-006, FR-007, FR-011 and the Edge Cases' polder/hill exclusion. Only the drop of _comb_toe_and_hem is replaced; FR-009's toe paddies and dry hem stay.

decisions.summary: Phase 1: the fit scores each trial size on its region (D2, its acreage); fan_admissible judges the built net, as today
decisions.why: FR-007: trial sizes 'MUST be scored on the region (its acreage AND ITS WATER'S LEGALITY) without cutting plots'. Today every trial is scored (not fan_legal(net), err) (fit.py _fit_at_aspect) and _finish_first_admissible orders and filters on that flag; D2/D8 score acreage only and move legality to the built winner. The search then ranks illegal sizes as admissible, and in Phase 0 the prototype's search skips work the current search does (SC-004). fan_legal reads the plots' extent (tail_dangles, flanks_commanded), but the region gives that extent, so legality on the region is not impossible. Fix: each trial size's water legality scored on its region, fan_admissible still judging the built net.

decisions.summary: The union prediction retired with what it predicted (area-sum lever dropped: no longer applies); trial count re-measured once a trial is cheap and kept or cut by that measurement
decisions.why: FR-010 as written: a lever kept where it still applies, dropped with its reason where the redesign removes what it acted on. The area-sum lever acted on planted_area's union, which FR-007 retires; the trial-count lever is decided by measurement.

decisions.summary: Phase 1's remaining design is amended into this plan after Phase 0 measures which parts survive
decisions.why: FR-005 orders Phase 0's verdict before any engine change; an amendment changes plan.md's digest and so comes back to this review.

decisions.summary: Constitution VI: a glyph-check of the paddy fabric on Inashiro declared as the delta's occasion
decisions.why: Verification of the changed placement rule the feature owes under standing review doctrine; not new scope.
